mentions.name: Price Drop Alert
mentions.description: A price drop alert scraper written in Python that runs as a daily cron job. It checks the prices of a list of URLs (mostly the author's clothing staples from outdoor retailers) and sends an email with any products that have gone on sale. The author has run it for over a year and now has a landing page gauging interest in a stupid-simple price watch service that requires no extension install or account.
mentions.problem: Existing price-tracking options require installing a browser extension or creating an account; this service aims to be stupid-simple instead.
mentions.audience: Shoppers who want a simple price-drop alert service without needing to install an extension or create an account; originally built for the author's own shopping
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been tinkering on a little price drop alert scraper written in Python. It's run as a cron job, and every day it checks the prices of a list of urls (my clothing staples from various outdoor retailers, mostly) and sends me an email with any products that have gone on sale.
